scenario: DS's no-unbounded-computation stance per LCYC.1 — a well-formed DAG rule graph (no cycles) compiles without error. Pin: three rules where A emits X, B matches X and emits Y, and C matches Y form a linear chain; this is accepted.
rules_ds:
schema Trigger scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Intermediate scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Result scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule stage_a:
    Trigger t
->
    emit Intermediate logical v: t.v

rule stage_b:
    Intermediate i
->
    emit Result logical v: i.v

rule stage_c:
    Result
->
    log info "done"
